rootCauses: USB removal ended the Xcode test connection; WDA became ready again with no previous session. The desktop remained blocked stopping a capture through its invalid old session route (HTTP 404).
Discovery treated an absent USB iPhone like a permanently stopped mirror instead of preserving it for reconnection.
Automation ignored connected after disconnected, and renderer input flow could stay blocked after automatic recovery.
changes: Confirm an owned capture is absent using read-only status and standalone capture lookup before accepting failed stop cleanup; preserve ownership if unconfirmed and never stop global broadcast.
Preserve USB iPhone windows and leases while absent; successful discovery reconnects only the same ready device key with one recovery operation at a time.
Recreate session only after owned cleanup completes; restore prior video mode through the shared input queue; no replay of previous input.
Require a new renderer presentation after transport recovery; reset failed local GUI input flow.

physical.automaticVideoRestoration: ReplayKit video mode confirmed in toolbar; fresh image visible
physical.inputRestored: GUI opened Utilities then Calculator; digit tap changed 6 to 61

limitations: One actual unplug/replug cycle verified; repeated rapid cycles, lock screen and multiple physical iPhones remain to be exercised.
WDA must be running/reachable; the desktop does not sign or launch a stopped Runner automatically.
Final video restoration was routed through the existing shared input queue after the physical run and covered by 27 targeted tests.
